Meetings.Discussions: Reviewed the checklist of mandatory submissions for all five bidders. Confirmed that all bids except Bidder 3 supplied original bid security and registration forms.
Meetings.Resolution: Passed Quality Builders, Modern Construction, Solar Waters, and Medical Supplies to Technical stage. Failed Bidder 3.

Meetings.Discussions: Audited engineering methodologies and structural drawings submitted by remaining bidders. Checked compatibility of proposed materials with local guidelines.
Meetings.Resolution: Approved technical designs for Quality Builders and Modern Construction. Requested clarifications from Zambia Solar Waters on panel mounting layouts.

Meetings.Discussions: Assessed technical specification matching scores and price schedules. Quality Builders scored highest overall with 91.5% technical score and lowest evaluated responsive price.
Meetings.Resolution: Recommend Quality Builders Ltd for the Rural Health Center award.

Meetings.MeetingTitle: Tender Kickoff & Conflict of Interest Declaration
Meetings.Discussions: Distributed evaluation guidelines, scorecards, and declarations of interest. All members signed declarations stating zero conflict with the bidders.
Meetings.Resolution: Agreed on evaluation timelines and milestones.

Meetings.Discussions: Presented findings from physical site audits of the bidders' equipment yards and completed reference projects in neighbouring districts.
Meetings.Resolution: Confirmed that Quality Builders and Modern Construction possess active yards, functional concrete mixers, and valid safety audit logs.

Meetings.Discussions: Finalized the evaluation report package and drafted the award notice. Checked compliance with Zambia Public Procurement Authority thresholds.
Meetings.Resolution: Signed off on the final recommendation report to award the contract to Quality Builders Ltd at ZMW 2,480,000.
